adalaj.name: Adalaj Stepwell (અડાલજની વાવ)
adalaj.summary: Adalaj Stepwell is a unique five-storey subterranean water building built in 1498 by Queen Rudabai in memory of her husband Rana Veer Singh. A masterpiece of Solanki and Indo-Islamic architecture, it showcases intricately carved friezes, octagonal openings, and multi-tier pavilion galleries.

timeline.title: Queen Rudabai Inception & Consecration
timeline.description: Constructed during the reign of Mahmud Begada in fusion Solanki-Sultanate style to provide sanctuary for travellers and water conservation.

timeline.title: Trade Caravan Route Oasis
timeline.description: Served as a vibrant subterranean social and trade hub along the historic Patan-Ahmedabad silk and spices highway.

timeline.title: Colonial Survey & Siltation
timeline.description: Surveyed by Archaeological Survey of Western India; documented lower-tier silt deposits and natural sandstone patina.

timeline.title: National Protected Monument & Digital Twin
timeline.description: Protected by ASI with active groundwater monitoring, laser scanning, and sustainable heritage illumination.

facts.text: Built in 1498 CE by Queen Rudabai, wife of Vaghela chieftain Rana Veer Singh.
Subterranean ambient temperature is approximately 5°C cooler than ground level.
Features bilingual Sanskrit and Arabic inscriptions on marble plinths.
Design allows minimal direct sunlight into the deep well shaft, preserving water clarity.

narration.en: Welcome to Adalaj Stepwell. Descend five tiers into the earth, where Solanki sandstone pillars meet Islamic floral geometry. Built in 1498 by Queen Rudabai, this sacred subterranean oasis cooled weary travelers and preserved precious monsoon water.
narration.hi: અડાલજની વાવ (अडालज बावड़ी) में आपका स्वागत है। धरती के पांच स्तर नीचे उतरिए, जहां सोलंकी नक्काशीदार स्तंभ और इस्लामी ज्यामिति आपस में मिलते हैं। १४९८ में रानी रूदाबाई द्वारा निर्मित यह पवित्र बावड़ी यात्रियों को शीतलता और जल प्रदान करती थी।
narration.gu: અડાલજની વાવમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. પૃથ્વીના પાંચ માળ નીચે ઉતરો, જ્યાં સોલંકી કંડારેલા સ્તંભો અને ભવ્ય કમાનો જોવા મળે છે. ૧૪૯૮માં રાણી રૂડાબાઈ દ્વારા બંધાયેલી આ ઐતિહાસિક વાવ જળસંચયનું અદભુત પ્રતીક છે.

warnings: Subterranean water table levels estimated from Central Ground Water Board seasonal records.

rani-ki-vav.name: Rani Ki Vav (રાણકી વાવ)
rani-ki-vav.summary: Rani Ki Vav is a UNESCO World Heritage stepwell in Patan, built by Queen Udayamati in the 11th century as a memorial to King Bhima I of the Chaulukya dynasty. Designed as an inverted subterranean temple, it holds over 500 principal sculptures.

timeline.title: Queen Udayamati Foundation
timeline.description: Constructed as an inverted subterranean temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu and his Dashavatara forms.

timeline.title: Saraswati River Siltation & Burial
timeline.description: Major avulsion and silt inundation by the ancient Saraswati River buried the structure in sand, preserving the sculptures intact.
timeline.source: Geological Survey of India Paleochannel Survey

timeline.title: ASI Excavation & Restoration
timeline.description: Systematic desiltation uncovered the 7 tiers of sculptures, torana arches, and water pavilions in pristine condition.
timeline.source: Archaeological Survey of India Vadodara Circle

timeline.title: UNESCO World Heritage Inscription
timeline.description: Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site Ref. 922 for outstanding universal artistic value.

facts.text: Constructed as an inverted temple highlighting the sanctity of water.
Features over 500 major sculptures and over 1,000 minor religious reliefs.
Depicted on the reverse of the Reserve Bank of India 100-rupee currency note.

narration.en: You are witnessing Rani Ki Vav, the Queen's Stepwell. Seven tiers delve 27 meters deep into the earth. Unlike conventional temples rising towards the sky, this sanctum descends into the underworld, worshiping water as divine nectar.
narration.hi: यह है पाटन की राणकी वाव, यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर। सात मंजिला यह वाव २७ मीटर गहरी है। आकाश की ओर उठने वाले मंदिरों के विपरीत, यह उल्टे मंदिर की तरह पाताल की ओर उतरती है और जल को देवतुल्य मानती है।
narration.gu: આ છે પાટણની રાણકી વાવ, યુનેસ્કો વિશ્વ ધરોહર. સાત માળ ઊંડી આ ભવ્ય વાવ પૃથ્વીના પેટાળમાં ૨૭ મીટર ઊંડે સુધી જાય છે, જેમાં ૫૦૦થી વધુ પવિત્ર મૂર્તિઓ કંડારેલી છે.

photos.title: Stepped Corridor of Rani Ki Vav
photos.author: Hiroki Ogawa

warnings: Ancient Saraswati River connection is inferred from paleochannel satellite radar.

modhera.name: Modhera Sun Temple & Surya Kund (મોઢેરા સૂર્ય મંદિર)
modhera.summary: The Sun Temple at Modhera is a dedicated solar monument built in 1026-27 CE by King Bhima I of the Chaulukya dynasty. It consists of the sanctum Gudhamandapa, the open pillared Sabhamandapa, and the stepped reservoir Surya Kund featuring 108 miniature shrines.

timeline.title: Solanki Solar Consecration
timeline.description: Constructed so that at the spring and autumn equinoxes, the first rays of the rising sun illuminated the golden idol of Surya.

timeline.title: Medieval Conflict Damage
timeline.description: Sanctum tower damaged during Delhi Sultanate campaigns; Surya Kund stepped geometry remained structurally sound.

timeline.title: Archaeological Conservation
timeline.description: Documentation and masonry stabilization by Archaeological Survey of Western India.

timeline.title: India's First 100% Solar-Powered Heritage Site
timeline.description: Integrated 3D night projection mapping, solar battery storage, and dynamic LED illumination.
timeline.source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

facts.text: Aligned with the Tropic of Cancer at 23.58° North latitude.
Surya Kund features 108 miniature shrines dedicated to various deities.
52 pillars in the assembly hall represent the 52 weeks of the solar year.

narration.en: Welcome to Modhera Sun Temple. On the equinox morning, the first beam of dawn cuts directly across the reservoir into the inner sanctum. The 108 miniature shrines of Surya Kund form a cosmic geometric stairway to the sacred waters.
narration.hi: मोढेरा के भव्य सूर्य मंदिर में आपका स्वागत है। विषुव (Equinox) की सुबह सूर्य की पहली किरण सीधे गर्भगृह में पहुंचती थी। सूर्य कुंड की १०૮ लघु देवकुलिकाएं जल की ओर उतरती ब्रह्मांडीय ज्यामिति का निर्माण करती हैं।
narration.gu: મોઢેરા સૂર્ય મંદિરમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. સૂર્ય કુંડના પગથિયાં પર બનેલા ૧૦૮ નાનાં મંદિરો પ્રાચીન સ્થાપત્ય અને જ્યોતિષ ગણતરીની અદ્ભુત કલા દર્શાવે છે.

photos.title: Surya Kund Stepped Reservoir and Shrines
photos.author: Naveen

warnings: Sanctum tower roof reconstructed based on contemporaneous Solanki Nagara treatises.

sanchi.name: Great Stupa of Sanchi (सांची स्तूप)
sanchi.summary: The Great Stupa at Sanchi is one of the oldest stone structures in India, originally commissioned by Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE. Its nucleus is a simple hemispherical brick structure with four elaborately carved stone torana gateways.

timeline.title: Mauryan Emperor Ashoka Inception
timeline.description: Ashoka commissioned the earthen core and erected a monolithic polished sandstone pillar with his edicts.

timeline.title: Shunga Expansion & Stone Casing
timeline.description: Stupa enlarged to double its original volume and encased with dressed ashlar slabs, harmika, and chhatra umbrella.

timeline.title: General Taylor Rediscovery
timeline.description: British officer General Taylor discovered the overgrown site; subsequent survey by Alexander Cunningham.

timeline.title: Sir John Marshall Comprehensive Restoration
timeline.description: Reassembled the fallen torana arches and established the Sanchi Archaeological Museum.
timeline.source: John Marshall: The Monuments of Sanchi

facts.text: Commissioned by Mauryan Emperor Ashoka in 3rd century BCE.
The four Toranas portray Jataka tales and events from Gautama Buddha's life without depicting Buddha as human.
Depicted on the reverse side of the 200 Indian rupee banknote.

narration.en: You are standing before the Great Stupa at Sanchi, where Buddhist architecture took stone form under Emperor Ashoka. The four monumental toranas depict Buddha not in human form, but through sacred symbols: footprints, the Bodhi tree, and the Dharma wheel.
narration.hi: आप सांची के महान स्तूप के सामने खड़े हैं। सम्राट अशोक द्वारा तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व में निर्मित इस स्तूप के चारों तोरण द्वार भगवान बुद्ध के जीवन और जातक कथाओं को पवित्र प्रतीकों के माध्यम से दर्शाते हैं।
narration.gu: સાંચીના મહાન સ્તૂપમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. સમ્રાટ અશોક દ્વારા સ્થાપિત આ પવિત્ર બૌદ્ધ સ્થાપત્ય શાંતિ અને અહિંસાનો પ્રાચીન સંદેશ આપે છે.

warnings: Torana arch reconstructions follow Sir John Marshall's 1912 archaeological reassembly.

qutub-minar.name: Qutub Minar (क़ुतुब मीनार)
qutub-minar.summary: Qutub Minar is a 72.5-metre tapering victory tower in Mehrauli, Delhi. Begun by Qutb-ud-din Aibak in 1199 and completed by Iltutmish and Firoz Shah Tughlaq, it is constructed of red sandstone and white marble with delicate muqarnas corbelling.

timeline.title: Qutb-ud-din Aibak Foundation
timeline.description: Constructed the ground-floor red sandstone fluted storey as a victory minaret.

timeline.title: Shams-ud-din Iltutmish Completion
timeline.description: Added three storeys of red sandstone with alternating circular and angular flutings.

timeline.title: Firoz Shah Tughlaq Marble Repair
timeline.description: After a lightning strike, replaced the top storey with two distinct white marble and red sandstone storeys.

timeline.title: UNESCO World Heritage Inscription
timeline.description: Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site along with the Iron Pillar and Alai Darwaza.

facts.text: Tallest brick minaret in the world at 72.5 metres (238 feet).
Surrounded by several historically significant monuments including the 1600-year-old rust-resistant Iron Pillar of Chandragupta II.
Contains 379 spiral staircase steps leading to the top balcony.

narration.en: Welcome to Qutub Minar. Soaring 72.5 meters above the Delhi plains, this tapering tower is an engineering marvel in fluted red sandstone and white marble, bearing intricate Qur'anic inscriptions and muqarnas balconies.
narration.hi: क़ुतुब मीनार में आपका स्वागत है। ७२.५ मीटर ऊंची यह मीनार लाल बलुआ पत्थर और सफेद संगमरमर की बनी दुनिया की सबसे ऊंची ईंट मीनार है।
narration.gu: કુતુબ મિનાર (દિલ્હી) માં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. ૭૨.૫ મીટર ઊંચો આ ભવ્ય મિનારો લાલ પથ્થર અને આરસપહાણની બેનમૂન કારીગરી દર્શાવે છે.

warnings: Top cupola was removed in 1848 by Major Smith and relocated to the surrounding garden.

somnath.name: Somnath Temple (સોમનાથ મંદિર)
somnath.summary: Somnath Temple is the first among the twelve Aadi Jyotirlinga shrines of Lord Shiva, located on the Arabian Sea coast in Prabhas Patan, Gujarat. Known as the Shrine Eternal, it was rebuilt repeatedly after historic destructions, culminating in the grand Maru-Gurjara style temple completed in 1951.

timeline.title: Early Solanki Reconstruction
timeline.description: Constructed in grand Solanki sandstone with gold kalasha on the Arabian Sea promontory.

timeline.title: Rani Ahilyabai Holkar Temple
timeline.description: Devout queen of Indore constructed a protected subterranean sanctum to preserve the sacred lingam.

timeline.title: Sardar Patel Modern Rebirth
timeline.description: Consecrated by Dr. Rajendra Prasad in authentic Maru-Gurjara Rekha-Nagara architecture.

timeline.title: Ocean Promenade & Digital Telemetry
timeline.description: Protected coastal defense promenade with sound and light laser heritage mapping.

facts.text: First among the twelve revered Jyotirlinga shrines of Lord Shiva.
An arrow pillar (Bāṇastambha) marks that there is no land mass between Somnath and Antarctica along that longitude.

narration.en: Welcome to Somnath, the Shrine Eternal. Standing where the Arabian Sea crashes against the Saurashtra coast, its towering Rekha-Nagara shikhara has stood resurrected through a thousand years of history.
narration.hi: सोमनाथ मंदिर — अनादि ज्योतिर्लिंग में आपका स्वागत है। अरब सागर के तट पर स्थित यह भव्य नागर मंदिर भारतीय संस्कृति की अदम्य जिजीविषा का अमर प्रतीक है।
narration.gu: પ્રભાસ પાટણ સ્થિત શ્રી સોમનાથ મહાદેવ મંદિરમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. બાર જ્યોતિર્લિંગોમાં પ્રથમ એવું આ ભવ્ય મંદિર સમુદ્ર કાંઠે શોભી રહ્યું છે.

warnings: Coastal erosion simulation modeled from INCOIS ocean wave height data.

kailasa.name: Kailasa Temple, Ellora (कैलाश मंदिर)
kailasa.summary: Kailasa temple (Cave 16) is the largest monolithic rock-cut Hindu temple in the world, carved out of a single basalt cliff face in the 8th century under Rashtrakuta King Krishna I at Ellora Caves, Maharashtra.

timeline.title: Rashtrakuta Krishna I Top-Down Excavation
timeline.description: Carved vertically top-down from living basalt; approximately 200,000 tonnes of rock removed without scaffolding.
timeline.source: Baroda Copper Plates of Karka II (812 CE)

timeline.title: Fergusson Archaeological Documentation
timeline.description: Measured drawings and structural documentation of Dravidian vimana and Ravana Phad reliefs.

timeline.title: UNESCO World Heritage Inscription
timeline.description: Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site Ref. 243.

timeline.title: Subterranean LiDAR & Stress Analysis
timeline.description: Structural displacement monitoring and 3D point cloud preservation.

facts.text: Carved entirely out of a single volcanic basalt cliff, from top to bottom.
Covers twice the area of the Parthenon in Athens and is 1.5 times its height.

narration.en: Welcome to Kailasa Temple at Ellora. Craftsmen started at the mountain peak and chiseled downwards, excavating 200,000 tonnes of basalt to reveal life-sized sculpted elephants, two victory pillars, and a towering multi-tiered sanctuary.
narration.hi: एलोरा की गुफा १६ — कैलाश मंदिर में आपका स्वागत है। दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा एकाश्मक (Monolithic) मंदिर, जिसे ऊपर से नीचे की ओर काटकर एक ही विशाल पहाड़ से गढ़ा गया है।
narration.gu: ઇલોરા ગુફાઓમાં આવેલ ભવ્ય કૈલાશ મંદિરમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. એક જ વિશાળ કાળા પથ્થરના પહાડને ઉપરથી નીચે કોતરીને આ અદ્ભુત મંદિર બનાવવામાં આવ્યું છે.

warnings: Basalt rock joint integrity modeled from GSI geotechnical reports.

taj-mahal.name: Taj Mahal (ताज महल / તાજ મહેલ)
taj-mahal.summary: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna River in Agra, India. Commissioned in 1631 by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan to house the tomb of his favourite wife Mumtaz Mahal, it also houses the tomb of Shah Jahan himself. Designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahori, the UNESCO World Heritage monument is widely considered the jewel of Indo-Islamic Mughal architecture, renowned for its symmetrical perfection, soaring onion dome, four detached minarets, and exquisite pietra dura semi-precious stone inlays.

timeline.title: Emperor Shah Jahan Memorial Commission
timeline.description: Commissioned in honour of Empress Mumtaz Mahal; master architect Ustad Ahmad Lahori begins layout on the Yamuna riverfront.

timeline.title: Main Marble Mausoleum & Onion Dome Completion
timeline.description: The central octagonal tomb chamber, monumental double dome, and Quranic calligraphic inlays designed by Amanat Khan are completed.
timeline.source: Inscriptions on Great Gate & Mausoleum Plinth

timeline.title: Charbagh Gardens & Four Minarets Finalized
timeline.description: The four 40-metre corner minarets, central lotus reflecting pool, mosque and Jawab are finished with total construction cost reaching 32 million rupees.

timeline.title: UNESCO World Heritage & Modern Conservation
timeline.description: Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site; Taj Trapezium Zone (TTZ) established to protect white marble from industrial emissions and yellowing.

facts.text: Built from translucent white Makrana marble from Rajasthan, which reflects shifting daylight hues from blush pink at dawn to pearl white at noon and golden bronze at dusk.
The four 40-metre corner minarets were deliberately designed with a slight outward lean (approx. 1 degree) so that in an earthquake they would fall away from the central tomb.
Features exquisite pietra dura (parchin kari) floral inlays utilizing jade, crystal, lapis lazuli, amethyst, and turquoise embedded into the marble.

narration.en: Welcome to the Taj Mahal in Agra, an eternal masterpiece of Mughal architecture rising on the banks of the Yamuna River. Commissioned in 1631 by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, its monumental bulbous dome soars seventy-three metres into the sky, framed by four elegant corner minarets and a central reflecting pool that mirrors its luminous white Makrana marble.
narration.hi: आगरा में यमुना नदी के तट पर स्थित विश्व प्रसिद्ध ताज महल में आपका स्वागत है। 1631 में मुग़ल सम्राट शाहजहाँ द्वारा अपनी बेगम मुमताज़ महल की याद में निर्मित यह सफेद मकराना संगमरमर का मकबरा भारतीय-इस्लामी वास्तुकला का सर्वोत्कृष्ट शिखर है। इसके चारों कोनों पर चालीस मीटर ऊँची मीनारें और केंद्र में विशाल गुंबद सुशोभित हैं।
narration.gu: આગ્રામાં યમુના નદીના કિનારે આવેલા વિશ્વ વિખ્યાત તાજ મહેલમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. 1631માં મુઘલ સમ્રાટ શાહજહાં દ્વારા બેગમ મુમતાઝ મહેલની સ્મૃતિમાં બંધાયેલ આ શ્વેત આરસપહાણનો મકબરો વિશ્વની સાત અજાયબીઓમાં સ્થાન ધરાવે છે. તેના ચાર ખૂણે ભવ્ય મીનારા અને મધ્યમાં વિશાળ ગુંબજ શોભાયમાન છે.

photos.title: Taj Mahal Frontal Elevation & Reflecting Pool
photos.author: Muhammad Mahdi Karim

warnings: Makrana marble translucent surface and pietra dura inlays rendered procedurally.

akshardham.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham, Gandhinagar (અક્ષરધામ ગાંધીનગર)
akshardham.summary: Swaminarayan Akshardham in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, is a colossal Hindu temple complex consecrated in November 1992 by Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Built entirely from 6,000 metric tonnes of pink Rajasthani sandstone without any structural steel or iron, the central monument rises 108 feet into the sky. It features 97 intricately carved pillars, 17 majestic domes, 8 ornate balconies, 220 stone beams, and 264 sculpted celestial figures, set within the 23-acre landscaped Sahajanand Van gardens and sacred water kund.

timeline.title: Yogiji Maharaj Vision & Conceptualization
timeline.description: BAPS spiritual leader Yogiji Maharaj envisions a monumental spiritual and cultural complex along the Sabarmati river basin in Gandhinagar.

timeline.title: Consecration by Pramukh Swami Maharaj
timeline.description: Consecrated on November 2, 1992 after 13 years of stone craftsmanship by hundreds of traditional artisans from Rajasthan and Gujarat.

timeline.title: National Solidarity & Memorial Sanctum
timeline.description: Establishment of universal peace memorial and permanent exhibition galleries on ancient Indian science and universal harmony.

timeline.title: Smart Solar Illumination & Laser Mapping
timeline.description: Sat-Chit-Anand water show digital projection mapping and 3D architectural preservation survey.

facts.text: Built from 6,000 metric tonnes of pink sandstone from Bansipaharpur, Rajasthan, assembled using ancient interlocking stone joinery without any steel or cement reinforcement.
The central monument stands 108 feet high, 240 feet long, and 131 feet wide, supported by 97 carved pillars and capped with 17 domes.
Surrounded by a 1,751-foot colonnade (Parikrama) and the 15-acre Sahajanand Van gardens with musical fountains and herbal groves.

narration.en: Welcome to Swaminarayan Akshardham in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Consecrated in 1992, this monumental pink sandstone masterpiece rises one hundred and eight feet into the sky without a single piece of steel. Featuring seventeen intricately carved domes, ninety-seven sculpted pillars, and sprawling colonnaded gardens, Akshardham stands as an eternal tribute to ancient Indian temple architecture, peace, and spiritual heritage.
narration.hi: गुजरात की राजधानी गांधीनगर में स्थित भव्य स्वामीनारायण अक्षरधाम मंदिर में आपका स्वागत है। 1992 में प्रमुख स्वामी महाराज द्वारा प्रतिष्ठित यह मंदिर 6,000 टन गुलाबी बलुआ पत्थर से बिना लोहे के प्राचीन शिल्पकला द्वारा निर्मित है। इसमें 17 भव्य गुंबद, 97 नक्काशीदार खंभे और मनोरम परिक्रमा पथ सुशोभित हैं।
narration.gu: ગુજરાતના પાટનગર ગાંધીનગરમાં સ્થિત ભવ્ય સ્વામિનારાયણ અક્ષરધામમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. 1992માં પ્રમુખસ્વામી મહારાજ દ્વારા પ્રતિષ્ઠિત આ દિવ્ય મંદિર કોઈપણ લોખંડ કે સ્ટીલ વગર 6,000 ટન ગુલાબી પથ્થરથી નિર્મિત છે. 17 ભવ્ય ગુંબજો, 97 કલાત્મક સ્તંભો અને વિશાળ સહજાનંદ વનથી ઘેરાયેલું આ મંદિર ભારતીય શિલ્પકળાનું ઉત્કૃષ્ટ શિખર છે.

warnings: Pink sandstone interlocking joinery modeled parametrically from BAPS temple specifications.

hawa-mahal.name: Hawa Mahal, Jaipur (हवा महल / હવા મહેલ)
hawa-mahal.summary: Hawa Mahal ('Palace of Winds') is a palace in Jaipur, India, built in 1799 by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh and designed by Lal Chand Ustad. Its unique five-floor exterior resembles a honeycomb with its 953 small windows called Jharokhas decorated with intricate latticework, designed to allow royal ladies to observe everyday street festivals without being seen.

timeline.title: Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh Commission
timeline.description: Constructed as an extension of the City Palace to harness cool breezes through Venturi effect.

timeline.title: Comprehensive Conservation & Restoration
timeline.description: Major structural preservation of sandstone jharokhas undertaken after 152 years.

facts.text: Features 953 small casements (jharokhas) each with tiny lattices to allow cool air currents through the Venturi effect.
Built from red and pink-hued sandstone without any solid foundation; sits on the edge of City Palace.

narration.en: Welcome to Hawa Mahal in the Pink City of Jaipur. Rising five storeys like the crown of Lord Krishna, its iconic honeycomb façade boasts nine hundred and fifty-three intricately carved casements designed to funnel refreshing desert breezes.
narration.hi: गुलाबी नगरी जयपुर में स्थित प्रसिद्ध हवा महल में आपका स्वागत है। 1799 में निर्मित यह पांच मंजिला महल अपनी 953 झरोखों वाली मधुमक्खी के छत्ते जैसी बनावट और शीतलता प्रदान करने वाले वेंटुरी प्रभाव के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध है।
narration.gu: જયપુરના ઐતિહાસિક હવા મહેલમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. 1799માં મહારાજા સવાઈ પ્રતાપસિંહ દ્વારા બંધાયેલ આ પાંચ માળનો મહેલ તેના 953 ઝરૂખાઓ માટે સમગ્ર વિશ્વમાં પ્રખ્યાત છે.

golden-temple.name: Harmandir Sahib / Golden Temple (स्वर्ण मंदिर / ગોલ્ડન ટેમ્પલ)
golden-temple.summary: Sri Harmandir Sahib, also known as the Golden Temple, is the preeminent spiritual shrine of Sikhism in Amritsar, Punjab. Designed by Guru Arjan Dev in the late 16th century, the sanctum sits inside a sacred man-made pool (Amrit Sarovar). In 1830, Maharaja Ranjit Singh overlaid the sanctum with 162 kg of pure gold foil, giving it its iconic radiant gilded appearance.

timeline.title: Guru Ram Das Excavates Amrit Sarovar
timeline.description: Holy pool excavated by the fourth Sikh Guru, creating the sacred reservoir.

timeline.title: Harmandir Sahib Completion & Guru Granth Sahib Installation
timeline.description: Sanctum completed by Guru Arjan; Adi Granth installed by Baba Buddha.

timeline.title: Maharaja Ranjit Singh Gilded Gold Foil Overlay
timeline.description: Overlaid with pure gold leaf and decorative copper plates by Maharaja Ranjit Singh.

facts.text: The sanctum is surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar lake and accessed via a marble causeway called the Guru's Bridge.
Designed with four entrances in all cardinal directions symbolizing universal acceptance regardless of caste or creed.

narration.en: Welcome to the Golden Temple in Amritsar, the holiest sanctum of Sikhism. Gleaming in the center of the sacred Amrit Sarovar lake, its gold-plated dome reflects the eternal message of universal peace, equality, and devotion.
narration.hi: अमृतसर में स्थित सिखों के पावनतम तीर्थ श्री हरमंदिर साहिब (स्वर्ण मंदिर) में आपका स्वागत है। अमृत सरोवर के मध्य स्थित यह स्वर्णिम मंदिर विश्वभर में शांति और समरसता का प्रतीक है।
narration.gu: અમૃતસર સ્થિત પવિત્ર સુવર્ણ મંદિરમાં આપનું સ્વાગત છે. અમૃત સરોવરની વચ્ચે સ્થિત આ દિવ્ય મંદિર સોનાના પતરાથી મઢેલું છે અને વિશ્વભરના શ્રદ્ધાળુઓ માટે આસ્થાનું કેન્દ્ર છે.

photos.title: Golden Temple Amritsar across Amrit Sarovar
photos.author: Dungodung

warnings: Amrit Sarovar reflective water and gold foil specular maps modeled parametrically.
